image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vintage, heavily rusted cast-iron sad iron (flatiron) resting on a textured purple fabric surface. The iron features a solid, looped metal handle attached to the top of a thick, wedge-shaped body. The soleplate has a distinctive scalloped or wavy edge design near the front. The entire object shows significant signs of age and oxidation, with a rough, brownish-orange texture covering the metal surfaces.
